objective: Run an opt-in unfamiliar-request pilot, provide native candidate review, prove remote NUC development, and preserve a common integration point for future modalities.

authority.decision_owner: Pilot participants for their data and Unison maintainers for software gates
external_actions: run inventory-bound validation on the dev NUC
push branches and merge after hosted CI

allowed_changes: content-free pilot signals and summary tooling
non_goals: collection of private request content in pilot telemetry

required_artifacts: native conversation, Braille, and visual equivalence
clean NUC revision and command record
prohibited_claims: participatory modality validation before real research

handoff.current_state: Pilot collection, enrollment controls, candidate review, synthetic canary mechanics, headless sessions, modality integration, security gates, and research preparation are implemented; the LAN-based NUC path is available for focused low-load validation.
handoff.next_action: When the owner returns, review enrollment language and run a small keyboard and visual pilot before any shared promotion decision.
